messages:
maya: FYI — after the KMS alias rotation last night some SCIM provisioning jobs for EU customers started failing. RBAC audit entries look incomplete (role names missing).

sam: ugh. seeing lots of `decrypt error` in the idp-proxy logs. can someone paste the exact message? @oncall?

jin: quick check — KMS rotation completed 02:04 UTC in eu-west-1, but there was a short retry loop on the rewrap lambda. not sure if some payloads were left with the old envelope.

dana: here's an example from the SCIM worker: ```error: jwe: failed to unwrap key: decryption failed: auth tag mismatch; claim extid=acct-12345```

sam: that auth tag mismatch smells like a rewrap/alg mismatch rather than network flake. did the idp change alg from RSA-OAEP -> RSA-OAEP-256?

jin: no ALG change on our side — rotation script only swapped alias pointer. but the idp-proxy has a cached key cache that might still try old KMS key material.

maya: impact: provisioning blocked for ~12 tenants (mostly EU), rollouts that map to new RBAC roles fail to apply because extid can't be decrypted to look up role mapping. audit logs show grant events but missing role metadata, so GC scripts can't reconcile.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T02:03:12Z to idp-proxy eu-west-1 succeeded (ci/rotary-keyswap).

dana: mitigation idea: temporarily point idp-proxy to previous alias (if available) to let pending messages decrypt, then run a safe rewrap pass on queued payloads. alternative: force re-encrypt of extid at source (requires idp cooperation).

sam: agree. can we quick-validate by decrypting one extid with previous alias from the audit backup? if so we can confirm rewrap is necessary.

jin: I have the old alias ARN in the rotation log. pinging KMS team to grant our rewrap lambda quick access to prev alias for testing.

maya: also raising an incident (I-2026-023). tagging security & oncall to capture compliance timeline. need a short blameless summary for SOC within 3 hours.

security-bot: policy-check: if we temporarily point proxy to old alias, ensure rotation TTL is recorded and a post-mortem includes key exposure review.

dana: noted. I'll keep an audit trail of actions and record SSM commands used to switch alias.

sam: opening a quick runbook for this: 1) test decrypt 1 extid with old alias 2) if success, either (A) switch proxy to old alias for 30m and drain queue OR (B) run rewrap job to new alias and confirm decrypt. 3) run RBAC reconcile and confirm audit events show proper role names.

maya: thanks — I'll coordinate with support for affected tenants and post status updates in #customer-success. marking as high priority. :white_check_mark:
